---
title: "Plot Demo"
subtitle: "Browse presentation recipes by chart type"
---

Each page collects applications of one chart type. The page appearance switches
between matching light and dark figures.

- [Lines](lines.qmd): Ramsey fringes, dense lines, pulse sequences, and decay envelopes
- [Bars and markers](bars.qmd): bars and markers
- [Heatmaps](heatmaps.qmd): continuous and diverging scales
- [Table](table.qmd): headers and cells
- [3D](three-d.qmd): Bloch sphere animations with and without axes
- [Diagrams](diagrams.qmd): control timelines, waveforms, spectra, and physical concepts
- [Colors](themes.qmd): 5-, 10-, and 20-color sequences, cycling, and background samples

Copy the shared layout recipe and config into your project from
[Usage Tutorial](../usage.qmd).
